title: Minnesota Family & Divorce Law Questions...Answered!
author: Jason Kohlmeyer
description:
Minnesota Family Law Podcast

Created & Written by: Jason Kohlmeyer, Minnesota Divorce & Custody Lawyer


Whether you’re in the middle of a messy custody case or just starting to think about divorce, the Minnesota Family & Divorce Law Podcast is your go-to resource for smart, straight-talking legal insights. Created by Jason Kohlmeyer, a 25-year veteran divorce attorney and partner at Kohlmeyer Hagen Law Office, this weekly podcast answers real questions about what happens in a divorce or family law case.


From “Can I keep the house in a divorce?” to “Do I have to pay child support if we share 50/50 custody?” "Is Alimony still a thing?" Every episode tackles a common (or sometimes very uncommon) family law question, sometimes ripped straight from the headlines. 


It’s like having your own private Minnesota family lawyer in your earbuds but minus the billable hour.


We cover everything from divorce, custody, child support, spousal maintenance, and co-parenting to prenups, domestic abuse orders, and the strange things that happen in family court, all in under 10 minutes an episode.


Why listen?


  • Created by a real Minnesota divorce lawyer—not a marketer, not a paralegal. Jason has handled thousands of family law cases from Mankato to Rochester and everywhere in between.


  • Clear and jargon-free: We break down Minnesota family law into plain English; we're not trying to impress anyone by using big words! 


  • Topical and timely: We don’t just talk law, sometimes we explain how divorce headlines and current events impact families here in Minnesota. 


Perfect for:

  • People thinking about getting divorced (or already in the thick of it)
  • Separated parents trying to understand custody laws
  • Anyone curious about how Minnesota family courts really work
  • Wanting a "second opinion" from what your current lawyer is doing


New episodes drop weekly. Subscribe now and start getting answers before you even set foot in a lawyer’s office or if you like scroll down and take a look at the topics that interest you!

title: Bonded From The Start
author: Laura Todd and Carina Lane
description:
Bonded from the Start is a podcast about perinatal mental health and infant and early childhood development — two fields that shape the same families and rarely get talked about in the same room.


Hosted by Carina Lane, founder of Mindfulstarts, a parenting coach & perinatal therapist, and Laura Todd, founder of Early Bonds Therapy, a perinatal and infant/early childhood therapist. Each episode bridges what a parent is carrying and what a baby is communicating. Topics cover what we, as clinicians, run into every day through our work with individuals in this period, alongside other professionals who specialize in these topics. 


We talk about matrescence, perinatal mental health conditions (PMHCs), attachment, co-regulation, responsive caregiving, and the postpartum months nobody prepares you for. It's a reflective lens holding space for both parent and infant to be seen as individuals and as a unit. All in language you can actually use.


If you're a parent, these are honest conversations that normalize the hard parts, make sense of your baby's behavior, and take the shame out of the days that feel like too much. If you're a clinician, birth worker, educator, home visitor, or early intervention provider, this podcast will provide relationship-based, reflective, culturally grounded practice you can carry into your next visit. 

Every family starts somewhere. These are the earliest relationships, the ones that teach a baby whether the world feels safe and teach a parent who they're becoming.


No perfection scripts. No quick-fix tips. Just curiosity, developmental science, and the belief that support shapes outcomes.


New episodes drop weekly on Wednesdays. Wherever you are in this transition, you don't have to figure it out alone.

description: I like to overanalyze my favorite TV shows and movies. I talk about the production side, behind the scenes, themes, symbolism, easter eggs, you name it!

title: Jade Guerra
author: Jade Guerra
description: Jade Guerra is a skilled healthcare professional who cares deeply about helping her patients feel their best. With experience in both chiropractic care and nursing, she takes a well-rounded approach to health. Jade Guerra focuses on spine care, preventing injuries, and improving her patients' overall quality of life. She works closely with each person to create care plans that meet their unique needs.

title: ZNO Industry Deepdive - Zochem AI
author: Zochem
description:
Have you ever wondered how zinc oxide is used to create so many things, from your daily sunscreen and tires to electronics and batteries? Welcome to ZNO Industry Deepdive, the AI-powered podcast from Zochem that simplifies the science, innovation, and everyday impact of zinc oxide, one of the world's most versatile materials.

In each episode, we take heavy technical concepts and turn them into clear, conversational deep dives. Whether you are an industry professional, a curious student, or someone who loves knowing how things work, we translate complex chemistry into engaging, easily digestible stories.

title: Disability is my Strength - The Podcast
author: Vicki Wilson
description:
Tired of disability being talked about as either tragedy or inspiration?
Disability Is My Strength is about the bit in between. Real life, real challenges, big ambitions and the assumptions people make along the way.
I’m Vicki Wilson, a disabled business owner, author and speaker living with cerebral palsy. Through solo episodes and guest conversations, we’ll talk about disability, confidence, inclusion, resilience, business and what it really means to create your own version of what is possible.
This isn’t about pretending barriers do not exist. It is about questioning the ones other people put in front of us and having honest conversations about how we move forward.
Expect personal stories, thought-provoking guests and plenty of straight-talking, with new episodes released regularly.

title: This Could Go Viral
author: Libby de Leon
description:
This Could Go Viral is the podcast for you.
If you’re a 90s kid or Gen Z, you didn’t just grow up on the internet, t he internet grew up with you.
From internet nostalgia, to algorithm changes to side hustles that accidentally become careers, This Could Go Viral is the playbook for navigating life on the internet.
You’re doomscrolling anyway.
You might as well make a little money off it.

title: Signal and Story
author: Pastime Agency
description:
Signal and Story is a relaxed weekly conversation for people who build and buy conversational AI: contact-centre platforms, voice agents and customer-service chatbots.
Each week, two hosts talk through the stories that caught their eye. Elena has run these deployments herself and brings the day-to-day view: who has to staff it, what changes for the team, and what a customer actually hears. Sam follows the market: who is moving, what things cost, and what a regulator has just changed.
It's not a debate and not a news bulletin. It's two people who know the field catching up over a coffee on what happened, why it's interesting and what it might mean in practice.
The hosts' voices are generated by AI (artificial intelligence). New episodes every week.

title: Kristi Muzzio
author: Kristi Muzzio
description: Kristi Muzzio is an accomplished opera singer and voice educator with a career rooted in performance, scholarship, and teaching. She holds a Doctor of Arts in Voice Performance and Pedagogy and advanced vocology training. Kristi has appeared in principal operatic roles and orchestral performances across the United States while focusing her work on vocal wellness, expressive artistry, student development, and expanding opera education through mentorship, research, performance leadership, and regional community engagement initiatives nationwide.

title: The Last Straw Podcast
author: Kristi Straw
description:
High achievers hit a breaking point. The world calls it burnout. We call it a reckoning.


The Last Straw is where executive women, founders, and quiet disruptors finally get the truth about leadership, identity, and the visibility required to grow your influence and your income. This is where the polished stage meets the real story. The boardroom meets the breakdown and rebuild. The ambition gets a voice.


Each episode pulls you behind the scenes of what actually happens after the keynote, inside high stakes rooms, and in the private moments leaders never talk about. You’ll hear the conversations clients whisper after the promotion. The fears that surface before the opportunity. The power moves that change everything.


Visibility becomes capital here. Presence becomes strategy. Voice becomes the asset that sets your career, your business, and your legacy on a different trajectory.


This is your entry point into the Lighthouse Leadership ecosystem. If you’re craving clarity, identity-led authority, and real elevation, you’re in the right place.


You’ll leave every episode feeling seen, activated, and a little giddy you found us.


Subscribe and step into the room.

title: Purity Bay
author: Elemental Gaming nexus
description:
Welcome ot Purity Bay! It ain't so pure. It ain't much of a bay. 

That’s Redacted is an actual-play Delta Green podcast. This campaign takes place in the homebrewed fictional town of Purity Bay, Illinois. 
In 1964, five towns became one county. About ten thousand people, dirt roads, one highway, a Walmart that ate the shops on the Main Streets, and a toy factory dumping pollution into the air. Surrounding it all is The Bed: a dead lake full of stranded ships, land races, and things people do where the lights do not reach. Deputy Jaime Prospero just came down from Chicago trying to make it to detective. Deputy Tim Brown has lived here his whole life and wants to keep the town safe. Florian Carter grew up getting shoved around by the same families, made it out, and has returned to do some method acting. A body on Buckberry Farm kicks off an investigation that will take us into the darkness of Purity Bay. 

You can expect serious moments, bad jokes and a whole lot of unantrual horror. Bonds will be damaged, lives will be lost and just maybe the Bay can be saved.

Gary and his 8-year-old daughter Isla learn how each sport works, talk about the big stories, share their favourite sporting moments and give their own take on what makes it fun.
From football and AFL to F1, tennis, cricket and plenty more, it’s a podcast for kids, parents and anyone who loves discovering sport together.

title: Ashes and Alleluias: Psalms from Under the Heart
author: Aaron J. Smith
description:
An audio companion to the sacred and scorched places we carry.
These are lo-fi meditations, prayers, and fragments of breath and grief recorded in the cracks of ordinary life. No polish. No pretense. Just a voice reaching out from under the heart, holding both ash and alleluia in the same trembling hands.
For those wandering, wondering, and whispering prayers on their breath.

title: Crime news

description:
Step into the world of crime, investigations, and breaking crime news. Behind the Crime brings you the latest cases, shocking incidents, major investigations, and the stories making headlines. We break down the facts, explore the events behind the headlines, and examine the people and evidence at the center of each case.
From developing stories to cold cases and high-profile investigations, stay informed with crime news delivered with clarity, context, and respect for those affected.
Listen. Investigate. Stay informed.

title: Boardroom Resilience: Your Weekly Security Update
author: The Logica Security Team
description:
Stay ahead of the threats that matter most. Each week, Logica Security brings you a concise executive briefing on the latest developments in cyber, information and physical security — and what they mean for your business.


Designed for boards and the C-suite, this five-minute update cuts through the technical detail to focus on risk, resilience, regulation and reputation. From major breaches to new laws and emerging technologies, you’ll hear what’s happening, why it matters, and the key questions every leader should be asking inside their organisation.


Clear. Actionable. Trusted.
 

Because resilience starts in the boardroom.

Whatever your river looks like right now, calm or rough, you were never meant to be in it alone.

title: The Ink Stays Dark
author: Adrian Klein
description:
The Ink Stays Dark explores the moral questions beneath crime, silence, memory, power, and the stories people try to control.

Hosted by writer Adrian Klein, the podcast moves through real cases, history, psychology, institutions, and fiction to examine what people do when truth becomes expensive.

Why do good people stay silent?

Why do some stories disappear while others refuse to stay buried?

What happens in the moments before a decision becomes visible?

The Ink Stays Dark began in psychological noir, but now follows the human pressure underneath it: witnesses, records, family secrets, corruption, responsibility, and the quiet choices that shape public truth.

For listeners drawn to moral ambiguity, institutional failure, memory, European noir, and the darker questions beneath ordinary life.

New episodes biweekly.

title: In the Company of Charity
author: Daughters of Charity
description:
In the Company of Charity is a podcast that invites listeners into meaningful conversations about the Catholic Church, society, and service to others, all through the lens of the spirit we've received from St. Vincent de Paul, the saint of charity. Hosted by the Daughters of Charity, each episode offers thought-provoking dialogue with nonprofit leaders, spiritual thinkers, and those working on the front lines of charity and advocacy. We explore how the spirit of service can inspire real-world action and personal transformation. Whether you're seeking spiritual enrichment or a deeper understanding of charitable work, you'll find companionship and insight here.

Join in the conversation by sending us your thoughts and questions at companyofcharity@gmail.com.

title: The Vanguard Wall Podcast
author: The Vanguard Wall Podcast
description:
Long-form interviews with combat veterans, special operators, and first responders — the people who did the hard things and carry them home. The host, an Army and law-enforcement veteran, goes deep on the moments most podcasts skip: the call made under fire, the teammate lost, and the long quiet work of putting it back together. Guests include Green Berets, Rangers, Delta, MACV-SOG, CIA, pilots, and police — plus founders, filmmakers, and voices in health and resilience. For warriors, and the families who love them. New episodes every other week.
Contact: admin@thevanguardwall.com

title: I Heard You When You Said
author: Justin & Stacey
description:
You've read the books. You've done the therapy. You've tried the journaling, the meditation, the coping strategies. And you still feel it — that familiar weight, that loop you can't seem to break out of.


This podcast is for people who understand themselves really, really well and still keep running into the same walls. Hosted by mindset coaches Justin Carroll and Stacey Hansen, each episode gives you something you can actually do — not just something to think about.


Justin and Stacey work at the intersection of language, story, and the nervous system, and they've built their Fortified Mind Method around one simple truth: your body is still living in a story your brain has already tried to reason its way out of. Understanding why you're stuck doesn't unstick you. Moving through it does.

Every episode pulls back the curtain on real client breakthroughs, practical word games and exercises, and the kind of catchy sayings that stick with you because they're actually true. You'll leave each episode with something to write down, something to try, and someone in your life you'll want to share it with.


If history keeps rhyming for you — if you're tired of pushing things down instead of laying them down — you're in the right place.

Not price, not speculation, but what it actually takes to own your money, your health, your food and your time.

title: Business and entrepreneurship

description: From Idea to First Paying Customer: What Actually WorksHosted by Vivian Solomon N.Turning a business idea into actual money is one of the hardest and most important steps for every entrepreneur. Many people get stuck between having a great idea and getting their first paying customer. This short, practical series is designed to close that gap.In these focused episodes, Vivian Solomon N. walks you through a clear, no-nonsense roadmap that works especially well in the Nigerian and African business environment. You will learn how to properly validate your idea before spending money, identify your very first ideal customer, package an offer people find hard to refuse, have effective sales conversations, and avoid the common mistakes that delay or kill early progress.This is not theory. Every episode is packed with practical steps, real-life style examples from the Nigerian market, and actionable advice you can apply immediately — whether you are starting a service business, selling products, or building something online.If you are tired of planning and ready to start earning, this series will give you the clarity and confidence to move from idea to your first paying customer.Perfect for: Aspiring entrepreneurs, side-hustlers, small business owners, and anyone who wants to stop overthinking and start selling.Business and entrepreneurship

title: Pleasure People
author: Danielle Bezalel
description: A thousand people. Three weeks. One question science rarely asks outright: what does daily pleasure actually do for you?   In this 6-part audio series, hosted by veteran sex educator Danielle Bezalel, Pleasure People follows eight participants of a first-of-its-kind intervention study that tracked pleasure's impact on sleep, stress, relationship satisfaction, and so much more. You'll hear directly from these participants about what it was like to have pleasure assigned and the lasting impact the study had on their lives. The findings will surprise you.  Danielle is joined by Magic Wand study lead researcher Dr. Candice Hargons and legendary sex researcher Emily Nagoski, Ph.D. to unpack the layered effect pleasure has on quality of life, and why self-pleasure has gotten such a bad rap.

title: What Now Then?
author: Jonathon Kelly
description:
What Now Then? is a podcast built around honest conversations with real people, real stories, and the moments in life that force us to stop and ask one simple question:

What now then?

Hosted by Jonathon Kelly in Western Australia, the podcast explores the turning points that shape who we become — the setbacks, breakthroughs, mistakes, relationships, challenges, losses, opportunities and unexpected changes that can completely alter the direction of a life.

This isn’t about pretending everybody has everything figured out.

It’s about what really happens behind the scenes.

Each episode brings a guest into a relaxed, genuine conversation about their life, their experiences and the lessons they’ve picked up along the way. Some guests may have achieved extraordinary things. Others may simply be ordinary people who have lived through extraordinary circumstances.

Either way, everybody has a story.

The conversations can move through relationships, recovery, mental health, family, personal growth, creativity, careers, business, purpose, success, failure and the difficult decisions we sometimes have to make when the life we expected doesn’t quite turn out the way we planned.

Because life rarely moves in a straight line.

Relationships change.

Careers change.

People change.

Plans fall apart.

Opportunities appear when we least expect them.

Sometimes we make the wrong decision. Sometimes we make the right decision and things still don’t work out. And sometimes the moments that feel like complete disasters at the time end up becoming the beginning of something entirely new.

Those are the moments What Now Then? is interested in.

This isn’t a traditional interview show built around rehearsed answers or carefully polished success stories. The goal is to create conversations that feel like you’re sitting in the room with us — curious, relaxed and willing to go wherever the discussion naturally leads.

There will be serious conversations.

There will be funny conversations.

There will probably be uncomfortable conversations.

And every now and again, we’ll disappear down a completely unexpected rabbit hole.

That’s part of it.

Jonathon isn’t sitting behind the microphone because he believes he has all the answers. The podcast exists because he still has plenty of questions.

What makes someone completely change direction?

How do people rebuild after things fall apart?

Why do some experiences stay with us for decades?

What have people learned about love, relationships, family, happiness, ambition and regret?

What does success actually mean once you’ve experienced it?

How do you know when it’s time to let something go?

And when everything changes…

What do you do next?

Sometimes one conversation can change the way you look at something.

Sometimes it’s a single story.

A mistake somebody admits to.

A lesson they learned the hard way.

Or one sentence that reaches you at exactly the right moment.

That’s what this podcast hopes to create.

Not perfect people.

Not perfect stories.

Just genuine human conversations about the experiences that make us who we are.

Season One marks the beginning of that journey — bringing together guests from different backgrounds, perspectives and walks of life, with each episode offering something new to think about.

So whether you’re rebuilding, changing direction, chasing something new, questioning where you’re heading, or you simply enjoy hearing fascinating people tell their stories, you’re invited to be part of the conversation.

title: This Wasn’t In The Brochure
author: thiswasntinthebrochure
description:
This Wasn’t in the Brochure: Because nobody prepared us for this shit.

Midlife was supposed to be the part where we finally had everything figured out.

Yeah… apparently not.

This Wasn’t in the Brochure is a podcast about the part of being a woman in midlife nobody really prepared us for—the hormones, the night sweats, the anxiety, the rage, the changing body, the changing relationships, the weird new relationship with alcohol, the kids needing us differently, and the unsettling realization that the life we spent decades building is changing.

But this isn’t a podcast about getting old.

It’s about figuring out what comes next.

I’m Abbigail Brown, and I’m right in the middle of it with you. I’m asking the questions, reading the research, talking to experts, trying the things everyone says will supposedly make our lives better—and reporting back on what actually works, what absolutely doesn’t, and what might be complete bullshit.

We’ll talk menopause, HRT, sleep, fitness, food, alcohol, mental health, marriage, friendships, money, purpose, aging, reinvention, and all the wellness crap suddenly being marketed to women our age.

And we’re going to try some shit, too.

New workouts. New hobbies. New places. Maybe meditation. Maybe surfing. Maybe salsa lessons. Maybe a retreat. Maybe something completely ridiculous.

Because somewhere between raising families, building careers, taking care of everyone else, and trying to remember why we walked into a room, a lot of us started asking the same question:

What do I actually want the rest of my life to look like?

I don't have the answer.

That's kind of the point.

Welcome to This Wasn’t in the Brochure.

Nobody prepared us for this shit.

So we might as well figure it out together.

description:
An unfiltered look at growing an e-commerce brand.
I’m a full-time landscaper, funding this business with my salary. It’s stressful, and the pressure is real. Did I mention I’ve got a 16-year-old and a 4-year-old? If it wasn’t for my lady, this would be near impossible.
My goal is to strip away the polished crap— chopping things up with edits and making everything sound better than it really is. From what I can see, that’s what a lot of businesses are doing.
I’m tired of reaching for guidance only to find that if someone is willing to work with a startup, they charge prices a startup can’t afford.
You want me to stop whining?
Already did.
Now I’m doing something about it.
You’ll see me set things up. You’ll see my stacks. You’ll see the numbers before and after the tests. I’ll tell you what worked for me, what didn’t, and what I learned along the way.
And if money is what’s stopping you from betting on yourself — I feel you. That was something that kept me stuck too.
And then it wasn’t.
I don’t make a lot of money, and it feels like there are a million hands reaching for whatever I do make. But I have a goal. A target.
I want to be the guy who changes the trajectory of my family and leaves behind generational wealth.
It’s scary. But I know I have to invest in myself before I can expect anyone else to.
I believe the smaller investments — the time, the money, the skills, the uncomfortable decisions — are what eventually get me to my target.
And I ain’t lying down until they do.
If you can do it for somebody else, you can do it for yourself.
So join me.
Get intentional.
Focus on the non-negotiables. The tasks that repeat every day and every week because they’re part of the system that makes your business money.
And above everything else, master your own mind.
Because most of the time, we throw in the towel on our challenges with our mind and our tongue before we ever see those challenges actually manifest.
So speak life. Speak abundance.
And…
Build.

Henty’s 'Young Buglers' immerses listeners in a gripping historical adventure, following the journeys of two brave boys, Jim and his best friend, as they navigate the challenges of military life. From the moment they leave home, the sound of their bugles becomes a call to honor, friendship, and survival amid the chaos of war.

As Jim and his friend face the trials of training, they uncover the stark contrast between the glory of heroism and the brutal truths of combat. Listeners will feel their hearts race as they confront danger, discover the meaning of loyalty, and grapple with the burdens of responsibility. The story delves into themes of bravery and sacrifice, all while keeping the listener on the edge of their seat with unexpected twists and turns.

Join these young buglers as they step into a world where every note played can mean life or death. With rich detail and compelling characters, 'Young Buglers' offers an insightful glimpse into a pivotal moment in history, making it a must-listen for fans of historical fiction and adventure. title: Between Qi and Science: My Experience of What Can't Be Measured
author: Axis Mundi Media + IRMCE
description:
Can healing be real if science can't measure it?
Between Qi and Science: My Experience of What Can’t Be Measured is a six-episode audio memoir about qi, Chinese medicine, and the limits of Western biomedicine. It follows a Cantonese immigrant sweatshop worker who became a self-taught community healer in Brooklyn's Coney Island. His son, Dr. Kin Cheung, a scholar of religion and Buddhism, takes us on the journey of living with and learning from his father.
The story starts with a teenage encounter with qigong (hei gong). From there it traces the sweatshop labor, poverty, and immigration that shaped a "wounded healer." Later episodes dig into acupuncture, placebo research, and the politics of "traditional medicine." Other episodes cover Asian American masculinity and stereotypes, and the challenge of holding mainstream medicine, Chinese healing practices, and Buddhism as equally real.
The series blends personal narrative, oral history, and religious studies scholarship. It's for listeners interested in alternative medicine, Asian American stories, religion and science, and healing and grief across generations.
Brought to you by Axis Mundi Media, Between Qi and Science is a limited series from the Institute for Religion, Media, and Civic Engagement ( IRMCE ( https://www.irmce.org/ ) ), in collaboration with the Asian Pacific American Religions Research Initiative ( APARRI ( https://aparri.org/ ) ) through generous funding from the Henry Luce Foundation as part of the Under Gods project.
Host: Dr. Kin Cheung
Executive Producer: Dr. Bradley Onishi

description:
When Angelica, the stunning daughter of the king of Cathay, arrives at Charlemagne's court, she ignites a fierce tournament that draws both Christian knights and cunning Pagans. The stakes? Her heart, offered as a prize to the victor who can defeat her formidable brother, Argalia. But the competition spirals into chaos as loyalties are tested and ancient rivalries resurface, setting the stage for a tale filled with adventure, romance, and betrayal.

In "Orlando Inamorato," Matteo Maria Boiardo weaves a vibrant tapestry of heroism and desire, where knights like Orlando and Rinaldo must navigate a world of enchantment and danger. As they pursue not just glory but the love of Angelica, each character faces a personal reckoning that challenges their ideals and destinies.

Listeners will be drawn into a world where magic and fate intertwine, where every decision could lead to triumph or tragedy. With themes of love, honor, and the pursuit of true identity, this audiobook invites you on an exhilarating journey through a landscape of duels, enchantments, and unexpected alliances. Will Orlando reclaim his honor and win Angelica's heart, or will the shadows of jealousy and ambition prove too great to overcome? Discover the epic battles and heartfelt struggles that define this classic tale, and find out what it truly means to be a hero in a world rife with temptation and intrigue.

Once the credits roll, we dive deep into the real-world impact, subtle plot holes, controversial character choices, and director's cut secrets. Zahir and Keeyana have overcome incredible tragedy and trauma. Through all of it, they held on to their faith. That faith carried them out of the darkest season of their lives and into the gym, where they found a new kind of strength in powerlifting, leading them to become champions in the space. But the strength that matters most isn't built under the bar. 
Faith Over Strength is where they bring the Bible into everyday life. On every episode, they share their story honestly, open up the verses that got them through, and talk about how faith can help you heal, rebuild, and thrive.
If you've been through the unthinkable and need to hear that it will be okay, this show is for you. Whatever your faith, you're welcome here.
"He giveth power to the faint; and to them that have no might he increaseth strength." Isaiah 40:29
Learn more at faithoverstrength.com.

title: In a Yellow Wood (A Satirical Exploration of Wealth)
author: Gore Vidal
description:
When wealthy stockbroker Anton discovers a hidden ledger detailing the dark underbelly of his elite social circle, he faces a moral reckoning that could shatter his gilded life. In Gore Vidal's 'In a Yellow Wood,' listeners delve into a razor-sharp satire that unearths the complexities of ambition, privilege, and the human condition. This gripping narrative unfolds within the opulent world of high finance, where the stakes are not just monetary but deeply personal. As Anton navigates betrayals, friendships, and the allure of power, he grapples with the question: what price are you willing to pay for success?

Vidal’s incisive wit and keen observations create a tapestry of characters who embody the contradictions of their society. Each interaction bubbles with tension, revealing the fragility of status and the often-hidden truths lurking beneath wealth. This audiobook invites you to reflect on the nature of morality in a world obsessed with appearances and status.

Through Anton's journey, listeners encounter a thought-provoking exploration of values and ethics that transcends time, prompting questions about our own ambitions and choices. Engage with a narrative that is both entertaining and enlightening, as 'In a Yellow Wood' challenges you to consider the cost of climbing the social ladder. Will Anton embrace the truth, or will he bury it beneath the gold? Tune in to discover how deep the roots of deception run in this captivating tale.

title: The Red Pen Podcast
author: Americans for Fair Treatment
description:
Government unions have spent decades writing their own rules. The Red Pen Podcast is here to mark them up.


Every other week, Americans for Fair Treatment CEO Chip Rogers and Senior Fellow Corey DeAngelis take a red pen to the latest news from the world of public sector and teachers unions. 


They break down the stories the unions would rather you didn't hear: corruption, intimidation of workers, union dues funneled into politics, and the fight to put kids ahead of union bosses in our schools.


Each episode features a high-profile guest from the front lines, including lawmakers, policy experts, and public employees who have stood up for their rights. Chip and Corey bring sharp analysis, plenty of candor, and a clear message: public employees deserve freedom, taxpayers deserve accountability, and parents deserve a say.


Whether you're a teacher, a first responder, a public employee, or a taxpayer footing the bill, The Red Pen gives you the facts and the fight.

New episodes biweekly. Learn more about your rights at afft.org.

description: New science, explained like a story. The Lab Report with MJ takes freshly published studies — cancer research, psychology, climate, tech, the occasional bat — and turns them into lively two-host conversations that are fun, quirky, and respectful of the real science. description:

Each month, Thomas sits down with a USU researcher to explore the discoveries, inventions, and ideas that are shaping Utah and the world beyond, from the lab to the field to your everyday life.

Along the way, "Random Sampling" digs into the personal stories behind the science: what sparked a researcher's curiosity, what challenges they faced, and why their work matters to the people who live, work, and learn in Utah. title: Slightly Un-Traumatized
author: Calley Merkel
description:
Have you ever had someone close a kitchen cabinet just a little too hard, or reply to your text message with a period instead of an exclamation point—and suddenly your heart rate hits 140 BPM because your brain assumes everyone is secretly furious with you?
Welcome to Slightly Un-Traumatized—the low-pressure podcast for anyone navigating adult life while managing a nervous system that stays on high alert.
Hosted by someone who is definitely not a wellness guru, this show is about making sense of childhood baggage, hyper-vigilance, and weird coping mechanisms—without taking ourselves too seriously. We are here to figure out why our adult brains keep running old survival updates and how to step off autopilot one micro-moment at a time.
What to expect:
Real Talk: Honest, down-to-earth conversations about people-pleasing, dissociation, hyper-independence, and emotional weather-checking.
Grounded Tools: Practical micro-practices and "age check-ins" for when your adult self needs to soothe your panicked inner kid.
Zero Judgment: A space to laugh at the chaotic reality of healing in real time.
What you won't find here:
❌ $300 crystal-infused water bottles
❌ Demands to "just let it go" or meditate away your fight-or-flight response
❌ Toxic positivity or pedestal preaching
Unclench your jaw, drop those shoulders down three inches from your ears, take a slow breath, and hit Follow to join the community. Let's re-parent the mess and figure this out together.

title: Tox N Talk

description: Tox “N” Talk We’re Trish and Tami, two Family Nurse Practitioners, two MedSpa owners, two very different roads into aesthetics, and absolutely no interest in sugarcoating what happens in this industry. Trish came into aesthetics with a background that already blended beauty and medicine. Before becoming a nurse, she spent more than 15 years as a professional makeup artist, then went on to build a career in Emergency Medicine and flight nursing before becoming a Nurse Practitioner and opening Tranquility Aesthetics & Wellness in Tarpon Springs, Florida. Her approach combines artistry, clinical experience, and a love for helping patients look like themselves, just refreshed. Tami brings more than 20 years of healthcare experience, with a background in cardiology, interventional radiology, and clinical management across neuro, orthopedic, trauma, and step-down care. After transitioning into aesthetics nearly a decade ago, she built her own MedSpa and developed a passion for injectables, lasers, hormones, wellness, and aging well. She is all about science, natural results, and helping people look better without looking “done.” Together, we created Tox “N” Talk — your weekly dose of unfiltered conversation about aesthetics, wellness, injectables, skincare, hormones, lasers, trends, treatments, and everything people are talking about behind the treatment-room door. We’re breaking down what’s actually safe, what’s worth your money, what’s overhyped, what makes us cringe, and what we would never do to our own faces. There will be science. There will be stories. There will definitely be opinions. And there may be a few industry secrets people wish we would keep to ourselves. We’ve worked in emergency rooms, trauma centers, flight nursing, hospital leadership, and yes, even jail medicine, before finding our way into the aesthetic world. Now we’re talking about the good, the bad, and the ugly of aesthetics from the perspective of two women who actually work in it every day. No corporate talking points. No filters. No pretending every new treatment is “game-changing.” Tox_N_Talk_Podcast_Description (1).pdf Just two Nurse Practitioners, two microphones, a lot of experience, and conversations we’re probably supposed to keep inside the treatment room. If you follow injectors, love aesthetics and wellness, are curious about the latest treatments, or simply want to know what’s really happening behind the perfectly filtered Instagram posts, pull up a seat. This is Tox “N” Talk. New episodes weekly

WTCK? – What the Company Knows? explores the intersection of knowledge and artificial intelligence in organizations. Hosts Stephan Ballenweg and Jakub Zavrel look beyond the AI hype to discuss what it takes to turn rapidly evolving technology into value.

title: Hey Beauty...
author: Hey...from K💋
description:
oooo yesss I'm so excited you're here!


I know this is where I'm supposed to have a clean, clear and cohesive message about what you can expect from the Hey Beauty podcast, but, I don't have it. 


Because self-exploration and evolution isn't linear or done in a step-by-step fashion. It's more of a spiral filled with detours and pivots and it's messy as fck. 


So there is no single way to describe the conversations or the "niche" this podcast fits into so I'm not even gonna bother trying. Also - I really hate feeling boxed in and want the freedom to talk about anything...so yah...hey beauty LOL


But what I can promise you is that we don't do surface level and we don't skirt around the truth. We are gonna go deep and we are gonna get down and dirty with everything YOU - knowing you, honouring you and owning ALL of you! 


I want you to walk away from these convos feeling witnessed, seen, and sometimes provoked. Because that's another thing about growth - it rarely feels good in the moment. SO yes, some of these topics will be triggering and they will uncover some shit you've been maybe trying to avoid or didn't even know were there, but I got you. 


If you're feeling like you wanna talk some of this shit out or be further expanded, I invite you to come hang with me in Hey Beauty HQ chat on Substack: https://substack.com/@heyfromk


SO YAH...I'm so glad you're here and can't wait to get to know you better.


Alright...chat soon!


K💋


Come find me:


Instagram + Threads + TikTok @hey.fromk 


Substack @heyfromk

description: College Women’s Basketball Podcast is not just another recap show. The women’s college game is growing fast, and this podcast takes you beyond the highlights, rankings, and final scores. title: Priority Intelligence
author: Daniel Matalon
description:
Priority Intelligence is a podcast about looking beyond the obvious.
Hosted by Joe Dalton and Daniel Matalon, the show brings together two very different perspectives to explore business, leadership, technology, economics and the decisions shaping our future.
Joe Dalton is a veteran broadcaster, business advisor, author and TEDx speaker with more than 30 years' experience working with founders, CEOs and leadership teams. A former chairman of Dublin South FM, Joe created and hosted an award-winning radio show before moving into podcasting. Over the years, he has interviewed internationally recognised thinkers and business leaders including Chris Voss, Dr. John Demartini and Dr. Marshall Goldsmith, as well as numerous guests who have appeared on Oprah.
Daniel Matalon is a strategist, entrepreneur and systems thinker whose career spans technology, operations, communications, media and organisational strategy. He is CEO of Impact Launchpad and founder of #IsThereEnough, an international initiative examining survival economics, scarcity, human agreement and some of the deeper assumptions underlying the way our societies and organisations operate.
Together, Joe and Daniel sit down with founders, CEOs, thinkers, innovators and people operating at the edges of change.
But the objective isn't another interview about someone's success story.
It's to find the thing underneath it.
What is really happening? What are we not seeing? What matters most now? And what should we be paying attention to next?
That's Priority Intelligence.

Drawing on over 15 years in the coaching seat, more than 350 client transformations, a background in policing, personal battles with depression, and the ongoing journey of becoming a stepdad, Ross shares honest conversations, real stories, and practical insights into what it actually takes to change.

This isn't a fitness podcast. It's a podcast about human behaviour.

Why confidence disappears, why standards collapse under pressure, and how to rebuild trust in yourself when you've drifted away from the person you know you're capable of becoming.

Grab a coffee. Bring an open mind. Welcome to Styled By Standards.

description: Who Really Got the Life Sentence? explores how ordinary people make extraordinary judgements about guilt, innocence and one another. In this podcast, we discuss topics facing parents today regarding their children's participation in youth sports. Each week, we will have a guest who adds pertinent expertise, and a child panelist to give their fresh take! Among others, topics will include overspecialization in sports today, sports burnout among adolescents, and positive coaching/positive parenting. The purpose of the show is to get parents to stop and think about what they really want their children to get out of their participation in sports, and to consider the results of their actions and interactions with their children before, during, and after their participation. No loud intros, no jarring cuts, no sudden sounds. Just long, wandering stories about real science, told slowly enough to let you drift off.

Put it on, close your eyes, and let your mind wander out into the dark and quiet.
Music and scripts are original to Sandman Science. Narration is an AI voice.

title: Podcast KTS Đới Doanh cùng Vua Tủ Nhựa
author: KTS Đới Doanh
description:
***********************************************************************************************
KIẾN TRÚC SƯ ĐỚI DOANH – TỪ NIỀM ĐAM MÊ BẢN VẼ ĐẾN HÀNH TRÌNH ĐỊNH HÌNH THƯƠNG HIỆU VUA TỦ NHỰA
***********************************************************************************************
Trong bức tranh nội thất kiến trúc hiện đại, sự chuyển dịch từ các vật liệu truyền thống sang vật liệu cao cấp, thân thiện với môi trường và bền bỉ theo thời gian đang trở thành xu hướng tất yếu. Đứng sau thành công và sự bứt phá của thương hiệu *Vua Tủ Nhựa* – đơn vị tiên phong trong giải pháp nội thất nhựa cao cấp tại Hà Nội – chính là *Kiến trúc sư (KTS) Đới Doanh*.
Với góc nhìn chuyên môn sâu sắc, nền tảng đào tạo bài bản cùng tâm huyết bền bỉ suốt 8 năm qua, KTS Đới Doanh không chỉ mang đến những sản phẩm nội thất tinh tế mà còn kiến tạo nên những không gian sống tiện nghi, ấm cúng và tràn đầy cảm hứng cho hàng ngàn gia đình Việt.
-----------------------------------------
1. Hành Trình Đào Tạo Và Dấu Ấn Quê Hương
-----------------------------------------
Nền Tảng Đào Tạo Kiến Trúc
--------------------------
KTS Đới Doanh tốt nghiệp chuyên ngành Kiến trúc tại *Đại học Mở Hà Nội* – một trong những môi trường đào tạo uy tín hàng đầu về mỹ thuật ứng dụng và kiến trúc tại Việt Nam.
Khoảng thời gian trên ghế nhà trường không chỉ trang bị cho anh tư duy hình khối, khả năng phối màu và kỹ thuật dựng không gian chuẩn xác, mà còn nuôi dưỡng trong anh một tư duy thiết kế lấy con người làm trung tâm. Mọi bản vẽ, từng đường nét cắt gọt đều phải phục vụ tốt nhất cho sinh hoạt hàng ngày của gia chủ.
Cội Nguồn Tạo Nên Sự Bền Bỉ
---------------------------
Sinh ra và lớn lên tại *xã Nghĩa Thịnh, huyện Nghĩa Hưng, tỉnh Nam Định* (sau đợt sáp nhập hành chính từ ngày 1/7/2025, địa danh chuyển thành *xã Đồng Thịnh, tỉnh Ninh Bình* ), KTS Đới Doanh mang trọn nét chất phác, kiên trì và chu đáo của người con vùng đất đồng bằng Bắc Bộ.
Chính tình yêu thương gia đình và sự trân trọng giá trị tổ ấm quê hương đã trở thành ngọn lửa thôi thúc anh không ngừng tìm kiếm giải pháp cải thiện chất lượng sống cho mỗi căn nhà Việt. Anh tin rằng: “Một ngôi nhà đẹp trước hết phải là một nơi an toàn, gọn gàng và mang lại sự bình yên cho tất cả các thành viên.”
------------------------------------------------------
2. 8 Năm Dấn Thân Vào Lĩnh Vực Nội Thất Nhựa Vượt Trội
------------------------------------------------------
Trước bối cảnh khí hậu nhiệt đới gió mùa tại Việt Nam – nơi độ ẩm cao, tình trạng mối mọt, ẩm mốc và cong vênh ở đồ gỗ công nghiệp diễn ra phổ biến – KTS Đới Doanh đã sớm nhận ra tiềm năng to lớn của *vật liệu nhựa nội thất cao cấp* (Zukoplast, Chin Huei, Vincoplast...).
Tính đến nay, anh đã có *8 năm kinh nghiệm thực chiến* trong ngành nội thất nhựa. Suốt gần một thập kỷ nghiên cứu và thi công trực tiếp:
* Anh liên tục thử nghiệm các dòng tấm nhựa thế hệ mới có độ nén cao, khả năng chịu lực vượt trội, chống nước tuyệt đối và chống cháy lan hiệu quả.
* Anh tối ưu hóa quy trình sản xuất, ứng dụng công nghệ cắt mộng, nẹp viền tự động giúp bề mặt nội thất nhựa đạt độ hoàn thiện sắc nét, sang trọng không thua kém các chất liệu cao cấp khác.
* Anh kiến tạo nên hàng trăm công trình thực tế, từ căn hộ chung cư hiện đại, nhà phố đến các văn phòng làm việc gọn gàng.
------------------------------------------------------------
3. CEO Vua Tủ Nhựa – Đưa Giải Pháp Nội Thất Xanh Đến Mọi Nhà

Trở thành *CEO kiêm Giám đốc Kỹ thuật của Vua Tủ Nhựa* , KTS Đới Doanh định hướng doanh nghiệp trở thành địa chỉ tin cậy hàng đầu cho khách hàng tìm kiếm giải pháp nội thất nhựa vừa túi tiền, bền đẹp và an toàn sức khỏe.

Dưới sự dẫn dắt của KTS Đới Doanh, Vua Tủ Nhựa không ngừng mở rộng danh mục sản phẩm nhằm đáp ứng trọn vẹn nhu cầu thiết lập không gian sống toàn diện cho gia đình:

title: The 7 Percent
author: Sullivan & Stanley
description:
93% of transformation programmes fail to deliver their full value. This is a show built entirely around the 7% who get it right.

The 7 Percent is a new podcast from Sullivan & Stanley, hosted by Group CEO Andy Haley, exploring what separates the organisations that deliver lasting transformation value from the vast majority that don't.


The premise is grounded in Sullivan & Stanley's own Intelligent Enterprise research: senior leaders are more confident than ever in their strategy, technology budgets have never been bigger, and yet value continues to leak out of transformation programmes at an alarming rate. The average organisation loses 27% of the value it originally committed to deliver: money, time and momentum that never makes it to the outcomes it was meant to fund.


Each episode cuts past the spin to talk honestly about what's working and what isn't. No platform to sell, no polished case study. Just an honest look at the reality of delivering transformation at scale.

title: Dolphin vs shark
author: Queen
description:
Dolphins vs Sharks: Who Really Rules the Ocean?
Dolphins and sharks are two of the most fascinating and powerful creatures in the ocean, but their abilities are very different. In this episode, we explore what happens when these marine predators cross paths.
We’ll compare their intelligence, speed, hunting strategies, strength, senses, and social behavior. Are dolphins really capable of defeating sharks? Do sharks actually fear dolphins? And what makes each animal such a successful survivor in the ocean?
Join us as we dive beneath the surface and uncover the truth behind one of the ocean’s most fascinating rivalries: Dolphins vs Sharks.

A new learning series with Rav Shlomo Katz on the sefer יין ישן by Rav Nissan.

Rav Shlomo returns to the inner foundations of Jewish life through a sefer that brings the world of Chassidus into clear, living language.

These shiurim are about the basics in the deepest sense: Emunah, closeness to Hashem, the Jewish soul, and the foundations that help a person live with more depth, simplicity, and truth.

title: The Digital Shepherd
author: 6:14 Ministries
description:
The Digital Shepherd is a podcast from 6:14 Ministries designed to help small and midsize churches communicate with greater clarity, creativity, and confidence.


Hosted by Josh Givens and graphic designer Jon Carlson, each episode brings practical, approachable conversations about graphic design, Canva, social media, church branding, websites, photography, presentation slides, AI, digital ministry, and the ever-changing world of church communications.


This show is especially for the pastor who wears six different hats, the church secretary who somehow became the social media manager, and the volunteer who was handed Canva and told, “Can you make something for Sunday?”


You don’t need a communications degree, a large staff, or a megachurch budget to communicate well. You just need a few good principles, the right tools, and the confidence to take the next step.


At The Digital Shepherd, we believe design isn’t just decoration, it’s communication. Clarity is an act of service. And faithful ministry deserves faithful communication.


Each episode combines practical training, real-world church application, a biblical perspective on communication and stewardship, and simple action steps you can put to work right away.


Because you don’t have to become a professional designer overnight. You just need to make the next thing better than the last one.


The Digital Shepherd is a podcast from 6:14 Ministries.

title: Truth in Motion with Dr. Jocelyn
author: Dr. Jocelyn Michel D.Ac-CHM
description: Truth in Motion exists to help people like you reveal what's been hidden, revive true life, and restore the original design. The truth in healing — for the whole person. Dr. Jocelyn Michel, Doctor of Acupuncture and insight coach, explores what actually makes us well: body, soul and spirit. Not fragments, not symptom-chasing — the whole person, in motion. A fellow traveler — with tools, a map, and a sense of direction — still learning and growing right alongside you.  Learn more at www.healingpathacupuncture.info. Dr. Jocelyn Michel is a licensed acupuncturist in the state of Wisconsin. This podcast is for educational and informational purposes only and is not medical advice.  It does not create a patient-practitioner relationship. Courtroom Chronicles brings true Indian legal battles to life through story, evidence, strategy, and the art of advocacy.
From criminal trials and constitutional battles to corporate disputes, arbitration, technology, intellectual property, and negotiations, each episode follows the people, evidence, decisions, courtroom strategies, and turning points behind real cases.
You don't need to be a lawyer to follow the story. The law is explained naturally as the case unfolds.
CASE → CHOICE → EVIDENCE → TWIST → VERDICT → LESSON
Listen to the case. Question the evidence. Understand the strategy.

title: Depression-Free After 40

description:
Depression-Free After 40


The Opposite of Depression is Not Happiness. It’s Fulfillment.


You did everything right. You built the career, raised the family, earned the title. 

Then, somewhere after 40, the color drained out. 

You're tired in a way sleep doesn't fix. You may feel like sleepwalking through life.


On paper, you're successful, yet you feel strangely empty.


Most people call that depression. My decades-long research has shown it’s something else: an unfulfilled life, the feeling of being unfinished. 


Research on the "happiness curve" shows that life satisfaction tends to hit its lowest point in our 40s and early 50s, often right when we've "made it." But why?


That timing is no accident. It's when needs we have postponed for decades finally demand to be heard.


Depression Free After 40 is the podcast for professionals, parents, and those in midlife and beyond who are ready to stop just managing symptoms and start living fully.


Every episode brings you:


The reasons. 

Why feeling unfinished spikes after 40, why success so often hides it, and why the usual fixes (work harder, push through, take the pill and carry on) rarely get to the root.

 

The Bill of Emotional Rights. 

Dr. Mehran's liberating framework of seven universal human needs we are wired to fulfill from birth. When these needs go unmet, we achieve loudly and ache privately. Depression deepens in such an environment. When we claim them, life opens up again.

 

The stories. 

Candid conversations with guests who have walked this path: leaders, physicians, artists, and everyday people who went from empty to fully alive, and share exactly how.


Your host. 

Dr. Ardeshir Mehran is a Columbia University-trained psychologist with more than 30 years of clinical work and a former leader who went through his own depression at the peak of his career. His work is a personal story of setbacks and revival. 


Dr. Mehran is the author of the bestselling book, ”You Are Not Depressed. You Are Un-Finished.”


Each episode brings Dr. Mehran’s signature warmth, clinical depth, fascinating discussions, and zero-nonsense directness to the questions that actually matter: 


Why do so many people suffer in silence, especially after 40? 

What do depression and anxiety know that you don’t? 

How do you go from managing symptoms to building a life that makes you feel fully alive?


This isn't a podcast about coping. It's about finishing what your life started, and learning to live, love, and lead better in the second half.

title: Everything's Funny With Helen Keaney
author: Helen Keaney, Jeremy Boguslaw
description:
Everything’s Funny with Helen Keaney is a comedy podcast about the people, stories and experiences behind the laughs.

After more than 30 years in stand-up comedy, and twelve years as a host on HSN, Helen Keaney sits down with fellow comedians, performers and people throughout the comedy industry for funny, candid conversations about life onstage and behind the scenes.

From breaking into stand-up to navigating show business, this podcast is for anyone who's ever wondered, "What would a life of stand up comedy be like?"  Helen uses her 30 years of experience to share tips she's learned, and talks with people she admires not just for what they’ve accomplished, but for who they are along the way.

Part comedy podcast, part inside look at the entertainment industry and part conversation between friends, Everything’s Funny With Helen Keaney celebrates the craft of comedy, the people who make it happen and the idea that, eventually, just about everything can be funny.

title: BorderlinerNotes: Real Therapy Sessions
author: BorderlinerNotes
description:
Welcome to BorderlinerNotes, a mental health channel focused - at present - mainly on personality disorders like Borderline Personality Disorder (BPD) and Narcissistic Personality Disorder (NPD).

The channel started as a way to make use of extra interview footage from the documentary film we made named BORDERLINE (more info / watch it at mndflds.com/borderlinethefilm). It has grown into a continued effort to offer information that might help people get a proper diagnosis and good treatment, as well as a place where clinicians and those working in the mental health field can learn to be better treaters. The goal is to democratize access to quality information, create positive change in the mental health field, and to do it artfully and with feeling.

BorderlinerNotes started as extra footage from the documentary BORDERLINE and became a rare resource in mental health education. The channel films real therapy sessions and consults between licensed clinicians and people diagnosed with Borderline Personality Disorder and Narcissistic Personality Disorder, then releases debriefs with both therapist and client. Clinicians include DBT specialists and experts in personality disorder treatment. The goal is to give people seeking help a look at what good treatment actually looks like, and to give therapists a model for better care. Follow the show and leave a five-star rating if you find it useful.
